dedupe_keys.name: bbr bygnings og boligregistret danish building and dwelling register

description: The Bygnings- og Boligregistret, BBR, is the Danish register of plots, buildings, technical installations and private dwellings, distributed through the national data distributor Datafordeleren. The file download service holds property-related entities including BBR cases, buildings, building-property relations, units, floors, stairwells, plots, cadastral parcel links and technical installations, and the object catalogue documents the bitemporal data model. Coverage: Denmark. Access: pre-generated JSON and CSV files, WFS entities, GraphQL and a BBR service, all after creating a Datafordeler user and an IT system with API key or OAuth; a total extract can be ordered by subscription. Licence: Datafordeleren terms, which forbid implying endorsement by the authority and require use in line with Danish law; free. Caveats: the data include personal property information, so recipients act as data controllers under data protection rules; field meanings follow Danish administrative definitions. Simulation uses are building-level inventories with use, area and installation data for energy, heat planning and exposure models. Related records: EUBUCCO, which harmonises European building data.
